long_biography.plain_text:
At the Turkish Education Foundation UK, Sezai Emin Taşkent serves as a joint trustee for a charity that funds scholarships for Turkish students in Britain and Turkey. His own education spanned economics at University College London, an executive MBA at Koç University and advanced management study at Harvard.

Taşkent's principal business responsibility remains STFA Group, the engineering company founded by his grandfather Sezai Türkeş with Feyzi Akkaya. He joined group boards in 1998, before succeeding to part of the holding previously controlled by his mother, Tomris Taşkent. Current ownership is divided equally among him and his brothers Alp and Nur. A professional chairman and chief executive leads the group, while Taşkent continues as a board member.
